subject: integration
name: IPFS standard (IPFS_0_2)
summary: A definition of IPFS_0_2: everything in IPFS_0_1, folder import as a CAR of up to 32 MiB, and three groups the definition says only the browser answers: preview, publish (provide, unprovide, a listing) and address (keyCreate, namePublish), the last two at risk 6. They describe announcing a kept folder and IPNS records to a relay and peers, after a site calls and, for an announce, the person says yes; the definition sends nothing itself. It cannot check that a node verifies blocks. Level 4 with privacy as a definition; the browser's own answers have no row. Judged here by its publisher.
